description: Redefine your shine with Meguiar's Professional Ultra Pro Finishing Polish M21032. Meguiar's Professional Ultra Pro Speed Polish M21032 is the perfect final step to obtain show car, swirl-free results after using Meguiar's M110 Mirror Glaze Ultra Pro Speed Compound to remove heavy defects and comes in 32 Oz or 1 gallon sizes.
